proposals.title: Guido Lorenzoni — MIT 14.451 Lecture Notes 5: Optimal Growth Model (Fall 2009)
proposals.date_scope: Fall 2009 is printed on the lecture; current retrieval does not change its original date.
proposals.use: Owned production/consumption budget and the distinction between positive consumption, envelope conditions and Euler equations.

inspection.body_scope: Physical/printed pages 1–3, section 1.1 and opening steady-state equation; actual PDF text and page 3 image.

image_scope.checked: Envelope derivative, interior effort-free investment Euler chain and explicit zero-capital discussion.

proposals.limits: The page 3 interior Euler chain omits beta in its last equality: U′=beta V′ requires beta U′(next) f′(next). We derive the correct relation directly. No general differentiability, stability or Inada theorem is imported.

proposals.title: Guido Lorenzoni — MIT 14.451 Lecture Notes 6: Euler Equations (Fall 2009)
proposals.date_scope: Fall 2009 lecture, not a current empirical finding.
proposals.use: Concavity and a vanishing nonnegative-capital shadow-value tail as a sufficiency route. Our finite-shock conditional proof states all expectation and tail hypotheses.

inspection.body_scope: Section 1, physical/printed page 1 through opening of page 2; both page images viewed.

image_scope.checked: Euler/TVC hypotheses and finite partial-sum cancellation.
Completion of the limit argument before section 2; local-stability material is not relied on.

proposals.limits: The third tail equality on page 1 prints F_y at date T+1 where the preceding Euler relation requires F_x. We retain the directly derived terminal term −beta^T u′(c_T) delta k_(T+1), avoiding that typo. No universal necessity of TVC, saddle-path or general measurable-selection claim.

proposals.date_scope: Fall 2009 lecture, source body and date inspected.
proposals.use: State includes observed Markov shock; finite shock histories versus general measurable-state models.

inspection.body_scope: Section 1, physical/printed pages 1–2 including the stated compact/bounded assumptions and general-state caution; both images viewed.

image_scope.checked: Observed state, finite transition law and bounded/compact hypotheses.
Contraction/value identification scope and explicit measurable-kernel extension caution.

proposals.limits: Our contraction theorem has finite states and finite actions; the broader compact-state theorem is not claimed proved. Source invariant-distribution/stability and continuous-shock results are not used.
